say:1:1530118001:1.text: I did. Cunning beasts, every last one of them!
say:1:1530118001:1.source_cn: 是啊。那些猿人，一个赛一个的狡诈！
say:1:1530118001:1.male: I did. Cunning beasts, every last one of them!
say:1:1530118001:1.female: I did. Cunning beasts, every last one of them!

say:2:1530118002:1.text: It took half a dozen Halians to pin me down, and another with a longbow shooting me from behind—otherwise I wouldn't be hurt at all!
say:2:1530118002:1.source_cn: 要不是有三五个呼临人围着我，还有个拿长弓的家伙从后面偷...
say:2:1530118002:1.male: It took half a dozen Halians to pin me down, and another with a longbow shooting me from behind—otherwise I wouldn't be hurt at all!
say:2:1530118002:1.female: It took half a dozen Halians to pin me down, and another with a longbow shooting me from behind—otherwise I wouldn't be hurt at all!
